paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: Comparison of the correlation between ChatGPT's QA performance and ground-truth vs. generated answers: Pop_GT vs. Pop_Ge, and RPop_GT vs. RPop_Ge.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart illustrates the correlation between ChatGPT’s question-answering performance and two types of reference answers — ground-truth (GT) and generated (Ge) — across three domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis represents the correlation coefficient, ranging from 0 to 0.7 in increments of 0.1, while the horizontal axis categorizes the data by domain. Four distinct bar types are shown for each domain, differentiated by color and pattern: solid orange for Pop_GT (popularity based on ground-truth), patterned orange for Pop_Ge (popularity based on generated answers), solid blue for RPop_GT (reverse popularity based on ground-truth), and patterned blue for RPop_Ge (reverse popularity based on generated answers). In the Movies category, RPop_GT and RPop_Ge show the highest correlations (approximately 0.35 and 0.63, respectively), while Pop_GT and Pop_Ge are lower (around 0.22 and 0.1). For Songs, RPop_GT and RPop_Ge again dominate (around 0.5 and 0.7), with Pop_GT and Pop_Ge at approximately 0.3 and 0.08. In Basketball, all correlations are lower, with RPop_Ge reaching about 0.2, RPop_GT around 0.13, and both Pop_GT and Pop_Ge near 0.07. The bars are grouped by domain and arranged in the same order for each, allowing direct comparison within and across domains. No bars are visually emphasized through shading or outlines beyond their inherent color and pattern coding.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the correlation between ChatGPT’s question-answering performance and two types of reference answers — ground-truth (GT) and generated (Ge) — across three domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis represents the correlation coefficient, ranging from 0 to 0.7 in increments of 0.1, while the horizontal axis categorizes the domains. Four distinct bar types are shown for each domain, differentiated by color and pattern: solid orange for Pop_GT (popularity correlation with ground-truth answers), patterned orange for Pop_Ge (popularity correlation with generated answers), solid blue for RPop_GT (relative popularity correlation with ground-truth), and patterned blue for RPop_Ge (relative popularity correlation with generated answers). In Movies, Pop_GT is approximately 0.22, Pop_Ge is ~0.1, RPop_GT is ~0.35, and RPop_Ge is ~0.63. In Songs, Pop_GT is ~0.3, Pop_Ge is ~0.08, RPop_GT is ~0.5, and RPop_Ge is ~0.7. In Basketball, Pop_GT is ~0.07, Pop_Ge is ~0.08, RPop_GT is ~0.13, and RPop_Ge is ~0.21. Across all domains, RPop_Ge consistently shows the highest correlation, followed by RPop_GT, while Pop_Ge and Pop_GT show lower and often comparable values. The chart visually emphasizes that relative popularity metrics (RPop) correlate more strongly with ChatGPT’s performance than absolute popularity (Pop), particularly when compared against generated answers.
model_annotations.German: The bar chart presents a comparison of correlation values between ChatGPT’s question-answering performance and two types of reference answers — ground-truth (GT) and generated (Ge) — across three domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical y-axis represents “Correlation” and is scaled linearly from 0 to 0.7 in increments of 0.1. The horizontal x-axis lists the three domains as categorical labels. Four distinct bar types, differentiated by color and pattern, represent the four correlation metrics: Pop_GT (solid orange), Pop_Ge (orange with diagonal stripes), RPop_GT (solid blue), and RPop_Ge (blue with diagonal stripes), as indicated in the legend. In the “Movies” group, Pop_GT is approximately 0.22, Pop_Ge is around 0.1, RPop_GT is about 0.35, and RPop_Ge reaches approximately 0.63. For “Songs,” Pop_GT is roughly 0.3, Pop_Ge is near 0.08, RPop_GT is about 0.5, and RPop_Ge is approximately 0.7. In “Basketball,” Pop_GT is around 0.07, Pop_Ge is about 0.08, RPop_GT is approximately 0.13, and RPop_Ge is near 0.21. The bars within each domain are grouped together and not sorted by height; however, RPop_Ge consistently shows the highest correlation across all domains, while Pop_Ge and Pop_GT are generally lower, with Pop_Ge being the lowest in Movies and Songs. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or annotations beyond their color and pattern coding.
